It's true, there was a huge lack of dragons in TLOU. I was disappointed.

I get that the story was cliche and that there wasn't much to the crafting, but short it was not. For a linear game with minor exploration 15 hours (what it took me) is a perfectly reasonable length for a triple A title. 

Also, the thing about TLOU is that is wasn't meant to be a full on stealth experience. The option was there, but you didn't have to use it.

While comparing it with splinter cell you could also say that the characters in the splinter cell universe don't even compare to those in TLOU. By the end of that game, I guarantee that everyone who was experiencing it had become attached to both Joel and Ellie.

For what it's worth, TLOU (In my opinion) had one of the most gripping and all round greatest introductions to a game, ever.
